name: Clean a messy lead CSV export into importable rows

parameters.content:
### How it works
Lead exports rarely import cleanly: the header says "E-MAIL" or "Last-Name " (stray space),
values carry leading spaces, one address is "ANA.KOVAC@PrimaStudio.rs", the next is
"marko.petrovic@ petroco.rs". This fixes that before the data reaches a CRM or a cold-email tool.
Press **Execute workflow**. It maps the header row onto "first_name", "last_name", "email",
"company", "domain", "phone", trims every value, lowercases and space-strips the address,
validates it, derives the domain, and adds "full_name". Rows that cannot be fixed come back in
"rejected" with a "reason" instead of disappearing.

### Setup
Nothing to connect: no credentials, no HTTP, no file paths, no data leaving your instance.
Replace the sample rows in **Messy lead CSV (paste yours)** with your own export. A title row
above the header is fine - the header is the first row with an email column, searched in the
first 20. To read a file instead, put *Extract from File* (CSV) in front of this node.

### Customization
Add a synonym to the header matcher if your column is named differently, loosen the email rule
for unusual addresses, or drop the "phone" mapping if you do not want phone numbers.

### Limits
Handled as-is: comma, semicolon and tab exports; quoted fields with commas, semicolons or line
breaks; ragged rows (listed, never silently dropped). Not handled: .xlsx must be saved as CSV
first, and a Windows-1250 export (names showing as "?or?e") must be re-saved as CSV UTF-8 -
the node receives text and cannot undo a decode that lost characters. No mailbox or MX check:
formatting is cleaned, deliverability is not.

Free workflow from the LeadFlow Automation Pack. The paid pack adds Google Sheets sync,
webhook capture and AI email drafts: [get the full 4-workflow pack]({{PAID_PACK_LINK}})

nodes.name: Overview - clean a messy lead CSV

parameters.content:
## 1. Paste your export
Header row required; a title row above it is fine. Columns are matched by name, so the order does not matter.

## 2. Clean, validate, report
Trim + lowercase, validate, derive the domain, list what could not be fixed.
